courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架
related.transfer: 可遷移「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」與「持載位移與時間效應」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Wedge weight and bolt direction" and "Hold movement and time effects" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力；鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架則以把鋼拱、格柵、噴凝土與基腳組成可驗證支護系統為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer; Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support centres on combine steel ribs, lattices, shotcrete and feet into a verifiable support system, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」與「榀距與分擔寬度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「複合噴層與變形相容」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Wedge weight and bolt direction” and “Rib spacing and tributary width”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Composite shotcrete and compatibility", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Wedge weight and bolt direction” and “Longitudinal bridging and reactions”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Pipe-umbrella presupport for tunnels, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道岩栓拉拔驗證
history.text: 本課討論的辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」到「試驗代表性與補強決策」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Wedge weight and bolt direction" through "Representativeness and reinforcement decisions" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
